title: Total influence of the OR function
statement: For every $n\ge 0$, let the sign-valued OR function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube equal $1$ when every coordinate is $1$, and equal $-1$ otherwise. Its total influence is $n/2^{n-1}$.
